<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex02032025-04-2513-15-11" status="finalized"><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:5611">'buM pa</rs>'i <note type="gloss">ji skad du</note> bshad pa ltar na <abbr>thams cad</abbr> gzung ba myed pa'i chos nyid kho na la sbyar ro || <note type="gloss">'o na byang chub seMs dpa' nyan rang gi nges 'byed mthong laM sgom laM <abbr>la sogs</abbr> <note type="editorial">la sogs unclear</note> pa'i rtogs pa °°° shes par byed °°° na | de dag gnas skabs gang du °°° par byed na</note> 
            <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3827">'brom</rs> ltar na nyan thos dang rang rgyal gyi nges 'byed dang mthong laM bsgom laM la sogs pa <abbr>thams cad</abbr> byang <lb edRef="inst:4454" n="1131b3"/> chub seMs dpa'i nges 'byed du shes par byed pa yin te | nyan thos kyi mthong ba'i laM gyi rtogs pas × kyang byang chub seMs dpa'i rtse mo'i rtogs pa las ma sleb pas de man chad du shes par byed la | rang rgyal gyi mthong laM gyi rtogs pas kyang byang chub seMs dpa'i bzod pa'i rtogs pa las ma sleb pas de man chad du shes par byed pa yin no || <!--TOCHECK: correct db for kun las btus pa-->
            des na <rs type="work" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3738">kun las <lb edRef="inst:4454" n="131b4"/> btus pa</rs> las gang zag gi brda' bsal ba dang | chos kyi brda' bsal ba dang | <abbr>thams cad</abbr> du gnyis ka'i brda' bsal ba'i mthong laM gsuM gsungs pa yang | rim pa bzhin du nyan thos dang rang rgyal dang byang chub seMs dpa' gsuM gyi mthong laM gsuM gsungs pa yin pas gang zag dang chos kyi brda' bsal ba gnyis ni byang chub seMs dpa'i nges 'byed du 'dus pa yin skad do ||
            <lb edRef="inst:4454" n="131b5"/> 'o na nyan thos dang rang rgyal gyi mthong laM rtog pa myed pa yin la byang chub seMs dpa'i nges 'byed ni rtog pa dang bcas <!--img. 602-->
         pa yin pas <note type="gloss">rtog pa <abbr>med</abbr> pa</note> de der <note type="gloss">rtog pa°°°</note> 'du bar mi rigs so byas pa la | nyan thos rang rgyal gyi mthong la rang yang rtog pa las ma 'das pa yin zer skad do ||
         
         de ni <note type="gloss"><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3807">'bre</rs> na re</note> mi rigs te | nyan thos dang rang rgyal gyi rtog pa dang bcas pa yin na | <note type="gloss">'o na nyan rang</note> de dag gis gang <lb edRef="inst:4454" n="1131b6"/> zag gi bdag myed pa dang gzung ba myed pa <note type="gloss">°°° mngon gsuM dang rtog pa °°°°°° |</note> mngon suM du ma mthong ba yin la | des na mthong bas spang bar bya ba'i sgrib pa las ma grol bar 'gyur ro || </seg></TEI>
